text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: AUTH_SERVICE_JWT_VALIDATION_ERRORS (P1) — page to on-call

incident-bot: Summary: Elevated 401s for token validation across hosted API; rate of failures ~7% over last 2m. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat.

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident created: INC-20260305-847 (escalation policy: infra-oncall).

sanjay (on-call): Ack. I'm on it. Pinging auth leads and security.

amanda (platform): Thanks. Any customer-facing impact numbers yet?

luis (auth): Seeing spike in jwt verification failures from our op logs. Error message is "kid not found in JWKS" coming from our verifier (go-jwt).

sanjay (on-call): Can you paste the verifier log and the JWKS fetch response?

luis (auth): Logs: 
```
2026-03-05T14:06:21Z auth-verifier service ERROR verify.go:82 token=eyJ... error="kid not found"
2026-03-05T14:06:22Z jwks-fetcher WARN jwks.go:45 fetched_jwks_keys=2 expected_kid=abcd1234
```

luis (auth): JWKS GET /well-known/jwks.json from our keyset service returns two keys: ["efgh5678","ijkl9012"], missing the kid expected by tokens (abcd1234).

sanjay (on-call): That suggests a key rotation where tokens still signed by old key are in flight. Do we have a cache TTL misconfiguration or propagation delay?

amanda (platform): Our deployment of key-rotation service rolled 3 minutes ago. Review shows key deprovisioning happened before signing stopped accepting old tokens. Probably race during rotation.

support-lead: Support alerting: We've seen ~12 customer tickets in last 10m complaining about 401s on API calls. Some premium customers affected. Marking "customer-impacting" and escalating.

platform-sec: Noted. Prioritize key material integrity. If there was an accidental deletion of signing key, we need to confirm HSM/KMS ops.

luis (auth): Quick mitigation options: 
- Re-add old public key to JWKS endpoint (fast).
- Disable strict "require kid present" check and fallback to legacy verifier for 10m (code change + deploy).
- Serve a 503 with message to clients (bad UX).

sanjay (on-call): Re-adding old public key to JWKS sounds safest and fastest. Can you rehydrate from key-store backup? How long to push?

luis (auth): I have the old key in our KMS metadata. Can generate the public JSON and POST to jwks-service. Doing it now, ETA ~2m.

ops-bot: Deploy started: jwks-service patch v2.14.8 -> v2.14.9 by luis. CI: passed.

luis (auth): Pushed old key to JWKS endpoint. Confirming fetchers have picked it up.

sanjay (on-call): Checking auth-verifier logs...

sanjay (on-call): Patch applied. I see the kid list includes abcd1234 again. Does log rate of 401s drop?

incident-bot: Metric update: jwt_validation_401 rate decreased from 7% -> 1.2% in 90s.

support-lead: Early customer triage: Significant customers XCorp and FinHQ reported errors. Please notify them and update support runbook.

amanda (platform): I'll draft a short customer message for support: explanation + apology + ETA for RCA.

platform-sec: We need an incident-scoped key rotation policy review. Did KMS record a delete or rotate event?

luis (auth): KMS audit shows an automated rotate event triggered by rotation service at 14:05:39 — it replaced primary signing key and removed the old public key from JWKS immediately. So yes race between token issuance and key publication.

sanjay (on-call): Root cause hypothesis: rotation orchestrator removed old public key from JWKS before existing tokens using that kid expired; our token issuance/consumption overlap window was not handled.

amanda (platform): Immediate actions: 
- Rehydrate old key (done).
- Add graceful key retirement: keep old pubkey in JWKS for X minutes after activate new key.
- Add telemetry and alert for sudden drop in jwks key count.

luis (auth): I'll open a PR with the JWKS grace window and emergency rehydrate script.

sanjay (on-call): For meantime, I'm going to contact the on-call for Dedicated customers to ensure no private clusters are affected. @support-lead please send the customer-facing note.

support-lead: Draft done. Sending to XCorp/SLA contacts now.

pagerduty: Incident status change: acknowledged -> in_progress (sanjay).

platform-sec: Confirming no KMS compromise. Rotate logs show proper KMS signing key but orchestrator order is wrong. No evidence of malicious activity.

luis (auth): Posted hotfix PR: add 10m retention to JWKS after rotation, and rehydrate script at tools/key-recovery.sh. Link: https://git.internal/repo/pull/421

amanda (platform): Can we add an automated smoke check post-rotation that simulates verifying tokens signed with previous kid?

sanjay (on-call): Yes add that. Also spike the incident timeline in the ticket. Assign follow-ups to luis (auth) and amanda (platform).

ops-bot: Deployment succeeded: jwks-service v2.14.9 -> live (all regions).

incident-bot: Metric update: jwt_validation_401 steady at 0.9% last 5m. Falling to baseline.

support-lead: Support: informing customers that issue is mitigated; will keep ticket open until RCA.

platform-sec: Flag for postmortem: ensure rotation protocol atomicity + KMS usage patterns. Add compliance check for rotations.

sanjay (on-call): Handing off to amanda (platform) for post-incident follow-through. I'm marking incident as resolved by mitigation but keeping PD incident open for RCA.

pagerduty: Incident status change: in_progress -> resolved (sanjay).

amanda (platform): Taking over. I'll schedule the postmortem meeting and the RFC for rotation grace policies.

luis (auth): Follow-ups I will own: (1) add JWKS grace window, (2) add CI smoke test, (3) emergency rehydrate runbook.

support-lead: We'll push a client email/ops post: "We mitigated an intermittent auth validation issue caused by key rotation timing — tokens briefly rejected; no data exposure."

sanjay (on-call): Quick checklist for postmortem: timeline, reproducer, KMS audit entries, telemetry gaps, customer impact, and remediation.

incident-bot: Incident closed in chat thread. Please link the incident ticket INC-20260305-847 and attach logs in the PM.

amanda (platform): Linking and will create the postmortem doc. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

luis (auth): One last note — if anyone sees residual 401s, please DM me directly and open a support ticket so we can correlate tokens.

sanjay (on-call): Good job. Handoff complete.

(End of thread)
